scope: Actual gameplay movement/spacing fix. No renderer, labels, HUD, main, version, damage amount, attack range/timing, actor cap, static facility position or old evidence edit by this agent. No browser, performance run or full 1000-session batch was started by this agent.

designBasis.requirement: World paths and XY collision shapes share geometry; no invisible blockers or false passages.
Dead/departed/migrated entities must not leave damaging ghost collision bodies.
Keep a bounded population rather than creating unlimited objects at cap.
Real-scale silhouettes must distinguish ordinary/elite trait bodies.
Real dense enemies/effects/foreground must leave targets/danger/weakness readable, including low effects.
AI, movement, attacks and collision stay in the same XY plane and use grounded entity positions.
Do not quietly remove enemies or change virus rules to meet a visual/performance target.

rootCause.source: src/game/battle.ts previous enemies pursuit used one exact player/tissue center and stopped at reach; moveWithCollision only knew fixed world footprints. No other enemy body occupancy was considered. Common source routes and parity-based fold tangents repeatedly delivered bodies to identical resting coordinates.

nearCoincidentOrdinaryGroups.note: Includes one ordinary at approximately941.95,1176.66 within2 world units of the group.

rootCause.interpretation: Thirteen live ordinary bodies occupy two tiny groups less than one body diameter apart. The actual PNG shows only a few crystal silhouettes in that patch. A world actor count or label displacement cannot repair this physical overlap.

implementation.softSeparation: Read one live-body snapshot, sort by stable ID, compute pair repulsion and antisymmetric ID-derived directions for exact coincident centers. Does not consume RNG. Return proposed positions; apply simultaneously before the existing enemy loop.
implementation.boundedMovement: Maximum spacing displacement is actual trait/slow-adjusted ordinary step multiplied by1.25. Every proposal uses existing moveWithCollision, explicit XY obstacle/bounds validation and a displacement cap. Alternate short tangents only replace a blocked separation direction when overlap energy decreases.
implementation.pursuit: If separation already used a body's movement budget, do not immediately walk it back into the same overlap. Otherwise preserve normal pursuit; a pursuit step that would deepen a live-body overlap tries stable shallow tangents or queues. No neighbor yields exactly the old static-collision trajectory.
implementation.fixedBodies: All defined attackAt poses, including due attacks before resolution, are fixed during the separation plan. Living source/core and migration actors constrain neighbors without moving themselves. Dead targets do not participate.
implementation.newWindups: A newly spaced idle enemy that remains in the existing reach can still start its ordinary windup immediately. Once accepted, that body's position, attackAt/aim/target remain locked until the existing resolution path. The fix does not retroactively drag an accepted warning to a new point. Remaining overlaps from pre-existing committed attacks can last until their short windup resolves; subsequent cooldown allows relaxation.
rulesPreserved: same-tick player vs tissue attack identities
implementation.realGameplayEffect: Crowded arrival order, reach eligibility, queued attackers, shot/range accessibility and total pressure can change because the physical positions now differ. This is an intended gameplay fix, not pure rendering; v075 win-rate, 1000-session and memory/performance conclusions cannot be inherited.

covered: 18 exact-coincident ordinary/elite bodies spread without deletion/HP/combat-field change and settle without ongoing isolated relaxation drift.
The pure simultaneous module gives the same plan for reversed input order, without adding an array-order contract to the whole existing AI.
Every corner/fold relaxation proposal stays inside world/obstacle bounds and its per-tick cap.
Committed windups/source/core/migration bodies do not move; dead neighbors do not constrain movement.
No-neighbor movement is byte-equivalent as numeric positions to existing static-collision movement; pursuit does not walk into a peer.
Actual GameSession pending windups stay unchanged and one same-tick player/tissue resolution still subtracts exactly7/4 with separate actor receipts.
Existing source/elite, three-trait G1 completion, population-bound, pulse area-control and campaign/travel mechanisms pass in the focused four-suite run.
